cleanupRules.cad.desc: Recovery and lock files. They are only useful if the program closed without saving.

duplicates.idle.description: Compares the actual contents of the files with SHA-256, not just name and size. To be fast, it first groups files by size, then reads only the beginning and the end, and reads the whole file only when there is still a tie. Hashes are stored in the catalog, so the next check is much faster.
duplicates.idle.safe: Nothing is deleted at this step: the check only reads the files.
duplicates.idle.title: Find identical copies, byte for byte
